item_short_desc: This versatile multi-tool set includes a fork, spoon, knife, corkscrew, can opener, bottle opener, 2 flathead screwdrivers, serrated knife with a sewing needle hole, and a hex wrench on the spoon handle. It comes with a convenient carry pouch featuring a M.O.L.L.E. attachment strap for easy portability. Perfect for camping, hiking, or any outdoor adventure, this set is designed to meet all your essential needs in one compact package.
